reason: 2,400 EUR plus 140 EUR every month for twelve months is almost 4,100 EUR in the first year, for a site that in Oradea costs 500 to 900 EUR. My clients come from conferences like this one and from referrals, not from a contact form, so the automations are solving a problem I do not feel badly enough to pay that much for.
objection: The founder does this 10 to 12 hours a week next to a day job. If the eligibility check or the document upload breaks during a call deadline, one working day for a reply is too slow, and I am tied into a 12-month subscription either way.
would_change_my_mind: If a consultant I know in Bihor showed me the document-chasing automation actually working on their clients and the setup price were around 1,200 EUR with no 12-month lock-in, I would look at it seriously.
